how: Swift extract/inline answers (curated by reading the diffs, 2026-11-14), LABELLING.md definitions. Plus the 300-commit practice datasets (vapor/vapor at e4a5b7050f, Alamofire/Alamofire at dea4bab917): every loose candidate from the engine-independent search, labelled blind by two independent Fable agents following harness/LABELLING.md, 2026-11-14, before any engine run on these datasets; where the two disagreed the label is borderline. Held-out curated items stay here and are repeated in locked-swift-extracts.json.
